author: Samwellys
body:
Hello. Me and some friends are making a return to competitive minecraft for some reason.

We're gonna take scrims serious but we're gonna take chill people over skilled people.

This is not an actual team, just people who want to play scrims together in a chill environment.
If you want to have an opportunity to play with some retired OCN legends, this is your chance.

Just reply beneath and if you're chill you can play. My discord is Sam#5014
